{{Quote|Darth Vader's recent visit was supposed to have eliminated the threat of sabotage.''"<br />"''So I understand. Apparently it did not.''"<br />"''If that is the case, we could, I expect, depend on another visit from Vader in short order. Not the worst thing that could happen to us, but certainly another burden we don't need, with sprawl construction nearly complete.|[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]]|<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>}}
A '''sprawl''', also known as a '''surface block''', was an area of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. It was smaller than a Death Star sector or zone. [[City Sprawl North 7: A68]] was an inhabited sprawl located in the Death Star's northern hemisphere.

City sprawls were also constructed on [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]].<ref name="TEGtVaV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

[[Teela Kaarz]]'s apartment was located in [[Sprawl 20]].

Commander [[Akobi]] was stationed in one of [[Section N-Twelve]]'s command sprawls, along the northern polar trench.
